name: vayuwise-ai
description: VAYUWISE AI - Your Family's Intelligent Clean-Air Companion

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'server', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'client', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.render-build: npm ci --include=dev --prefix ./server && npm ci --include=dev --prefix ./client && npm --prefix ./server run build && npm --prefix ./client run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test

author: VayuWise AI Team
